delivery_rules: Copy the selected files byte-for-byte to each prefix, preserving directories, notices and case-sensitive filenames.
Serve current_prefix files directly, without redirecting the client to GitHub. Snapshot prefixes remain fixed after publication.
Fetch on the maintained build side using normal permitted authenticated/public source routes, not in the arriving browser or agent.

Fail closed on missing files, source commit mismatch, unexpected Git blob/size, declared SHA256 mismatch, Git LFS pointer instead of data, or unexpected active content. Never substitute an error page.
Retain the last good publication on an acquisition or verification failure; do not relabel it latest.
Inspect document dependencies and fragment links. List still-external destinations explicitly as provenance, history, third-party work or participation; do not silently claim all links are local.

Default site-owned navigation to local readings; preserve original GitHub source locators separately. Do not globally rewrite preserved raw source bytes or silently change the Explore source contract.
Expose a small resource catalogue with source revision, status, original source URL, local file addresses, bytes and verified SHA256 for each copy.
Update CHANGES.md only with actually reached build/publication/delivery status. No timeless freshness or provider-admission claim.
